children: SoftBank Group seems to have the wiggle room to keep making big investments, Mitsubishi UFJ Morgan Stanley Securities' Nobuhiko Ambiru says in a note. The Japanese technology investment company said Wednesday that it would repay an outstanding $25.9 billion loan balance taken under a bridge facility agreement for its OpenAI investments, ahead of schedule. While SoftBank didn't discuss how it would fund the repayment, Ambiru suspects it may have used margin loans with Arm Holdings shares as collateral. SoftBank has a majority stake in Arm. Thanks to an increase in net asset value since the previous fiscal year ended March, SoftBank appears capable of maintaining its fiscal management policy with some buffer, the senior credit analyst says.
